scope: S-35 live room only. S-31, S-33, S-34 and the S-35 refund journey are untouched.

assertions.r1_rootHeight: live-room root height == available viewport height within 1px
assertions.r2_noScroll: scrollHeight<=clientHeight+1 and scrollWidth<=clientWidth+1 for page, body, #app, device viewport, live host, live root, stage
assertions.r3_threeRows: exactly three layout rows: header / minmax(0,1fr) stage / dock
assertions.r4_dockVisible: mic, camera, device-settings and Leave fully visible without scrolling
assertions.r6_noOverlap: no overlap between controls, safe area, mentor name badge or self-view; self-view stays inside the stage
assertions.r7_selfView: self-view moves through all four corners; minimised exposes exactly one non-overlapping 44x44 restore control
assertions.r8_sheet: details sheet stays inside the live root, adds no scroll, traps focus, closes on Escape, restores focus to its trigger
assertions.r9_keyboard: every control keyboard-reachable in DOM order with a stable accessible name
assertions.r10_console: zero console errors, zero warnings, zero page errors, zero failed requests
assertions.r11_states: camera-denied, mic-denied, disconnected/reconnecting, provider-failure, leave-confirmation and device-release preserve the same geometry
assertions.r12_ready: the run waits on data-live-room-ready="true" with a bounded rejecting timeout; no fixed sleeps
assertions.r13_bannerContent: [D-1] every provider-error/reconnect banner state the state model declares passes the nine content-geometry rules: 18-24px status icon; non-zero visible title and detail; message column >= max(120px, 40% of the banner); text inside the banner; no icon/text overlap; scrollWidth<=clientWidth; nothing clipped by an overflow:hidden ancestor; banner inside the mentor tile and stage; readiness never counts as a visual pass on its own

ruleText.g1_iconBox: status/warning icon width AND height each within 18-24px
ruleText.g2_textRendered: title and detail each have non-zero rendered width and are visible
ruleText.g3_textColumnWidth: message column >= max(120px, 40% of banner width)
ruleText.g4_textWithinBanner: title and detail rects stay within the banner rect
ruleText.g5_noIconTextOverlap: icon rect and text rects do not overlap
ruleText.g6_noHorizontalOverflow: scrollWidth <= clientWidth for the title/detail container
ruleText.g7_noClippedText: no text clipped by an overflow:hidden ancestor
ruleText.g8_bannerWithinTile: banner stays inside the mentor tile / stage
ruleText.g9_readinessNotSufficient: readiness awaited; data-live-room-ready alone is never a visual pass
